title: Comparison of Intraoperative and Postoperative Outcomes of Bartholin Gland Marsupialisation Versus Cystectomy
brief_summary: To compare intraoperative and postoperative outcomes of Bartholin marsupialisation versus excision
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-40, Bartholin cyst/abscess

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with systemical diseases, patients with recurrent Bartholin abscess
